install.title: Install the Dafter app first
install.why: Your login and attendance key live inside the installed app, so sign in there, not in the browser.
install.ios: Tap the Share button, then "Add to Home Screen". Open Dafter from your home screen.
install.other: Open the browser menu and choose "Install app" or "Add to Home Screen". Then open Dafter from your home screen.
install.then: If the app asks for it, copy the same invite link again and paste it there.
